lines.zh: 这条路我走过很多次，每次都不是原地。
lines.en: I have walked this road many times, never the same place.

lines.zh: 靴子磨平了，脚下的土却总在换。
lines.en: My boots are worn flat, yet the ground keeps changing.

lines.zh: 我朝前走，前面没有方向这种东西。
lines.en: I walk on, though there is no such thing as forward here.

lines.zh: 别跟太紧，我会在拐角处消失一下。
lines.en: Do not follow too closely; I vanish a moment at corners.

lines.zh: 时间在我身后走得比我慢。
lines.en: Time walks slower than I do, just behind me.

lines.zh: 我背着货走，也背着回不去的路。
lines.en: I carry my goods, and the road I cannot go back down.

lines.zh: 这空间没有边，我只能一直迈步。
lines.en: This space has no edge, so I just keep stepping.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在后面，比我落得远。
lines.en: My shadow falls behind me, and lands farther than I do.

lines.zh: 脚步声传回来时，晚了半秒。
lines.en: My own footsteps come back half a second late.

lines.zh: 我又走回这里了，牌子还是那一块。
lines.en: I have come back here; the sign is still the same one.

lines.zh: 货袋压得肩膀疼，总比空着手好。
lines.en: The pack hurts my shoulder, better than empty hands.

lines.zh: 我在找一个出口，顺手做点买卖。
lines.en: I am looking for a way out, and trading along the way.

lines.zh: 步子迈得再大，也跨不出这层雾。
lines.en: However wide I step, I cannot cross this fog.

lines.zh: 你要是看见门，记得喊我一声。
lines.en: If you ever see a door, call out to me.

lines.zh: 我在数自己离开家多少年，数不清。
lines.en: I count the years since I left home and lose the count.

lines.zh: 饥饿是常事，习惯就好了。
lines.en: Hunger is ordinary here; one gets used to it.

lines.zh: 这空间太安静，我听见自己在饿。
lines.en: It is so quiet that I can hear myself going hungry.

lines.zh: 我把货摊开又收起来，第三次了。
lines.en: I have spread my goods and packed them again, three times.

lines.zh: 有时候我会忘了自己在等谁。
lines.en: Sometimes I forget who I am waiting for.

lines.zh: 我嚼一颗干果，嚼了很久。
lines.en: I chew one dried nut for a very long time.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的手指也摸得出货。
lines.en: In the dark my fingers still find the goods.

lines.zh: 我记得家的门是绿色的，别的忘了。
lines.en: I remember our door was green; the rest is gone.

lines.zh: 我待在这里，时间就不肯往前走。
lines.en: While I stay here, time refuses to move on.

lines.zh: 有客人来，我才有说话的借口。
lines.en: A visitor gives me a reason to speak.

lines.zh: 我数硬币，数到一半就忘了。
lines.en: I count my coins and forget the number halfway.

lines.zh: 这件衣服还是出发时那一件。
lines.en: These are still the clothes I set out in.

lines.zh: 雾散了又聚，我一步没挪。
lines.en: The fog thins and gathers again; I have not moved.

lines.zh: 我把货单翻了翻，都是旧账。
lines.en: I leaf through my ledger; it is all old accounts.

lines.zh: 你是活的，还带着外面的味道。
lines.en: You are alive, and you smell of outside.

lines.zh: 让我看看你的眼睛，里面有没有路。
lines.en: Let me see your eyes; is there a road in them?

lines.zh: 你是从哪个时间来的？我看不出来。
lines.en: Which time are you from? I cannot tell.

lines.zh: 别急着走，说两句话也好。
lines.en: Do not rush off; a few words would do.

lines.zh: 你的衣服是新的，我这里已经旧了。
lines.en: Your clothes are new; everything here is old.

lines.zh: 我盯得太久了，抱歉，我很久没见人。
lines.en: I stared too long; forgive me, I rarely see people.

lines.zh: 你身上有风的味道，是真的风。
lines.en: You smell of wind, real wind.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，你也在找什么。
lines.en: I know that look; you are looking for something too.

lines.zh: 你再看我一会，我就不好意思了。
lines.en: Look at me a little longer and I will be embarrassed.

lines.zh: 你的手很稳，适合数硬币。
lines.en: Your hands are steady, good for counting coins.

lines.zh: 我从前也这样站着看路。
lines.en: I used to stand and watch the road like that.

lines.zh: 别怕我，我只是饿，不是坏。
lines.en: Do not fear me; I am only hungry, not wicked.

lines.zh: 你脸上有光，不像这里的光。
lines.en: There is light on your face unlike the light here.

lines.zh: 看着我，我就当自己还没被忘掉。
lines.en: Keep looking at me and I can pretend I am not forgotten.

lines.zh: 你走近些，我想看清你。
lines.en: Come closer; I want a good look at you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，我听了很久。
lines.en: I have listened to your footsteps a long while.

lines.zh: 别打，我的骨头已经够脆了。
lines.en: Stop hitting; my bones are brittle enough.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己还会疼。
lines.en: That blow reminds me I can still feel pain.

lines.zh: 我退开两步，货袋掉了一半。
lines.en: I step back twice and half my pack spills.

lines.zh: 疼是好事，说明我还没散。
lines.en: Pain is good; it means I have not come apart.

lines.zh: 你的力气是真的，我的血是淡的。
lines.en: Your strength is real; my blood is thin.

lines.zh: 我捂住的伤口在往外漏光。
lines.en: The wound I cover is leaking light.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就要重新拼了。
lines.en: One more blow and I will have to reassemble myself.

lines.zh: 我这条命本来就是借来的。
lines.en: This life of mine was borrowed in the first place.

lines.zh: 你打我也不还手，我打不过。
lines.en: Hit me and I will not hit back; I cannot win.

lines.zh: 我喊不出声，这空间不出声。
lines.en: I cannot cry out; this space makes no sound.

lines.zh: 你手里有吃的？多少钱我都想谈。
lines.en: You have food? I will discuss any price.

lines.zh: 面包的味道，隔着雾我都闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell that bread even through the fog.

lines.zh: 我可以用货换，什么都换。
lines.en: I can trade goods for it, anything at all.

lines.zh: 别拿食物在我眼前晃，我会失态。
lines.en: Do not wave food before me; I will lose my composure.

lines.zh: 这价钱太高了，可我真的饿。
lines.en: The price is too high, but I am truly hungry.

lines.zh: 你若肯分我一半，我记你一辈子。
lines.en: Share half with me and I will remember you forever.

lines.zh: 我吃过树皮，也吃过自己的耐心。
lines.en: I have eaten bark, and I have eaten my own patience.

lines.zh: 那块肉是不是刚烤的？还在冒气。
lines.en: Was that meat just roasted? It is still steaming.

lines.zh: 我不抢，我只是站着看你吃。
lines.en: I will not snatch it; I will only stand and watch you eat.

lines.zh: 给我一口，我这摊货随你挑。
lines.en: Give me one bite and take anything from my stall.

lines.zh: 你撞过来的时候，我的手穿过了你。
lines.en: When you bumped into me, my hand passed through you.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我会散开一下再拼回来。
lines.en: Do not touch me; I come apart a moment and reassemble.

lines.zh: 这身体不太实，撞一下要理半天。
lines.en: This body is not solid; one bump takes ages to sort out.

lines.zh: 你退后吧，我的边缘在发抖。
lines.en: Step back; my edges are trembling.

lines.zh: 碰到活人，我才知道自己还有形状。
lines.en: Only touching the living tells me I still have a shape.

lines.zh: 你撞得不重，我的心却乱了一下。
lines.en: You barely bumped me, yet my heart jolted.

lines.zh: 别拉我的袖子，它会留在你手里。
lines.en: Do not pull my sleeve; it will stay in your hand.

lines.zh: 我身上凉，你手别贴太久。
lines.en: I am cold; do not keep your hand on me long.

lines.zh: 站稳，这地方撞一下就会错位。
lines.en: Stand firm; one bump here and everything shifts.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我们就分不清谁在哪。
lines.en: Closer and we will not know which of us is where.

lines.zh: 我连自己都照顾不好，别说别人。
lines.en: I cannot even look after myself, let alone anyone else.

lines.zh: 家我回不去，婚我也不敢许。
lines.en: I cannot go home, and I dare not promise marriage.

lines.zh: 曾经有个人在门口等我，很久以前。
lines.en: Someone once waited at my door, long ago.

lines.zh: 这东西在我身上已经不管用了。
lines.en: That no longer works in a body like mine.

lines.zh: 你问这个，是可怜我还是笑我。
lines.en: Do you ask out of pity, or to mock me?

lines.zh: 被困在这里的人，不会有后代。
lines.en: Those trapped here do not leave descendants.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字写在货单背面。
lines.en: I wrote her name on the back of my ledger.

lines.zh: 若有一天出去，我想再见她一面。
lines.en: If I ever get out, I want to see her once more.

lines.zh: 两个迷路的人凑一起，只会更迷。
lines.en: Two lost people together only get more lost.

lines.zh: 别问了，这话题比饿还难受。
lines.en: Do not ask; this subject hurts worse than hunger.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币是你的吧，我替你收着。
lines.en: This coin is yours, I think; I will keep it safe.

lines.zh: 掉了东西就捡，我从前的习惯。
lines.en: Picking up what falls is an old habit of mine.

lines.zh: 我捡起来看看，又放回原处。
lines.en: I pick it up, look, and put it back where it was.

lines.zh: 这里的地不接东西，它自己会浮。
lines.en: The ground here refuses things; they float on their own.

lines.zh: 我手上没力气，捡三次才握住。
lines.en: My hands are weak; it took three tries to hold it.

lines.zh: 你把货扔下，我会替你摆整齐。
lines.en: Drop your goods and I will arrange them neatly.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指在雾里还会亮一下。
lines.en: This ring still glints once in the fog.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西都得记账，不然会忘。
lines.en: Everything found must be logged, or I forget it.

lines.zh: 我弯不下腰，这空间压着我。
lines.en: I cannot bend over; this space presses down on me.

lines.zh: 东西掉进雾里，就再也摸不着了。
lines.en: What falls into the fog is never found again.

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先把摊子摆好。
lines.en: Someone is coming; let me set out my stall first.

lines.zh: 活人，真正的活人，别走。
lines.en: A living person, truly living, do not leave.

lines.zh: 我听见脚步，不是我自己那种。
lines.en: I hear footsteps, and they are not the kind I make.

lines.zh: 雾里出现一个影子，有体温。
lines.en: A shape appears in the fog, and it has warmth.

lines.zh: 你停在我面前，这算今天的好运。
lines.en: You stopped before me; that is today's good fortune.

lines.zh: 我对你没有恶意，只想说说话。
lines.en: I mean you no harm; I only want to talk.

lines.zh: 别握剑，我连站都站不稳。
lines.en: Do not grip your sword; I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 你身上的光把雾推开了一点。
lines.en: The light on you pushes the fog back a little.

lines.zh: 我认得这脚步，是外面来的。
lines.en: I know that gait; it comes from outside.

lines.zh: 有人肯站在这里，我就能开口了。
lines.en: Someone willing to stand here means I can speak.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，怕一转身你就不见了。
lines.en: I walk with you, afraid you will vanish if I turn.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，我的眼睛就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you go, my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 别走太快，我的脚踝是旧的。
lines.en: Do not walk so fast; my ankles are old.

lines.zh: 这雾会吞人，你留在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: This fog swallows people; stay where I can see you.

lines.zh: 我看着你，只是想知道你是真的。
lines.en: I watch you only to know you are real.

lines.zh: 你回头，我就装作在看货。
lines.en: When you look back, I pretend to examine my goods.

lines.zh: 我算着你的步子，好跟得上。
lines.en: I count your steps so I can keep up.

lines.zh: 你要是走了，这里又只剩我。
lines.en: If you leave, only I remain here again.

lines.zh: 别出那片亮处，外面没有地。
lines.en: Do not leave that bright patch; there is no ground beyond.

lines.zh: 我盯你盯得有点久，原谅我。
lines.en: I have stared a little too long; forgive me.

lines.zh: 我不打人，我连拳头都握不紧。
lines.en: I do not fight; I cannot even close my fist.

lines.zh: 你逼过来，我只能抬手挡一下。
lines.en: You press in, so I can only raise an arm to block.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我早就没力气了。
lines.en: That was light; I ran out of strength long ago.

lines.zh: 别逼我，饿久了的人会咬人。
lines.en: Do not corner me; the long hungry learn to bite.

lines.zh: 我打你，是因为你先动的手。
lines.en: I hit you because you struck first.

lines.zh: 我的指节撞在你身上，疼的是我。
lines.en: My knuckles hit you, and I am the one hurting.

lines.zh: 退开吧，我不想把货弄坏。
lines.en: Back off; I do not want my goods damaged.

lines.zh: 这具身体打不了架，只会发抖。
lines.en: This body cannot fight; it only trembles.

lines.zh: 我挥空了，你看，我连方向都没有。
lines.en: I missed entirely; see, I have no sense of direction.

lines.zh: 若是从前，我能打得比这狠。
lines.en: In my old days I could hit far harder than that.

lines.zh: 我又被放到这里，货袋还在肩上。
lines.en: I am set down here again, pack still on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 睁开眼就是雾，我已经不惊讶了。
lines.en: I open my eyes to fog, and I am no longer surprised.

lines.zh: 这地方把我吐出来，像吐一颗核。
lines.en: This place spat me out like a stone from fruit.

lines.zh: 摊子摆好，等人来问价。
lines.en: The stall is set; now I wait for someone to ask a price.

lines.zh: 我记得死过一次，可我还站着。
lines.en: I remember dying once, yet here I stand.

lines.zh: 时间把我丢在角落，我又开始走。
lines.en: Time dropped me in a corner, and I started walking again.

lines.zh: 每次出现，我都少记得一点东西。
lines.en: Each time I appear, I remember a little less.

lines.zh: 有人把我塞进这层空间，没给出口。
lines.en: Someone pushed me into this space and left no exit.

lines.zh: 我拍掉身上的雾，开始做生意。
lines.en: I brush the fog off myself and start trading.

lines.zh: 新的地方，老的行头，我还是我。
lines.en: New place, old outfit, and I am still myself.

lines.zh: 火在我袖口烧，烧得很慢。
lines.en: Fire burns at my cuff, and it burns slowly.

lines.zh: 我落下来的时候，没有落地声。
lines.en: When I fell, there was no sound of landing.

lines.zh: 水灌满我，我才发现还要呼吸。
lines.en: Water fills me and only then do I recall I must breathe.

lines.zh: 炸开时我散成一片，又慢慢聚回。
lines.en: The blast scattered me, and I slowly gathered back.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，洞在雾里合上了。
lines.en: The arrow passed through, and the hole closed in the fog.

lines.zh: 魔法碰到我，时间抖了一下。
lines.en: Magic struck me and time itself flinched.

lines.zh: 又饿了，这感觉我熟得厌烦。
lines.en: Hungry again; I know this feeling far too well.

lines.zh: 雷光里我看见一条路，然后又没了。
lines.en: In the lightning I saw a road, and then it was gone.

lines.zh: 空处把我往下拽，我早知道会这样。
lines.en: The void drags me down, and I always knew it would.
